objective: Canario 4/6: comprobar unicamente indices que incluyan PersonaID en dbo.CavaSocios_Socios.

queries.name: personaid_index
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_disabled FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name=N'PersonaID' AND i.is_hypothetical=0 ORDER BY i.name
